title: Install DRF
question_text: Which pip package installs Django REST Framework?
explanation: The package published for DRF is djangorestframework.

title: Enable DRF
question_text: Where should rest_framework be added in Django settings?
explanation: Add rest_framework to INSTALLED_APPS.

title: Serializer import
question_text: Which import provides DRF serializers?
explanation: DRF serializers are imported from rest_framework.

title: Serializer base class
question_text: Which base class is used for a basic serializer?
explanation: A basic serializer inherits from serializers.Serializer.

title: ModelSerializer
question_text: Which class creates serializer fields from a Django model?
explanation: ModelSerializer maps model fields to serializer fields.

title: ModelSerializer Meta
question_text: Where is the model declared in a ModelSerializer?
explanation: The inner Meta class declares model and fields.

title: All model fields
question_text: Which value includes all model fields in a ModelSerializer?
explanation: The special value is the string '__all__'.

title: APIView import
question_text: Where is APIView imported from?
explanation: APIView is in rest_framework.views.

title: Response import
question_text: Where is DRF Response imported from?
explanation: DRF Response is in rest_framework.response.

title: GET handler
question_text: Which method handles GET in an APIView?
explanation: APIView dispatches GET requests to get().

title: POST handler
question_text: Which method handles POST in an APIView?
explanation: APIView dispatches POST requests to post().

title: Parsed request body
question_text: Where does DRF expose parsed request data?
explanation: request.data supports parsed request content such as JSON and form data.

title: Return API data
question_text: Which is the normal DRF response?
explanation: Response supports content negotiation and renderers.

title: Status constants
question_text: Where are HTTP status constants imported from?
explanation: Use rest_framework.status.

title: Created response
question_text: Which status represents successful resource creation?
explanation: 201 Created is commonly returned after creating a resource.

title: Bad request
question_text: Which status code represents a client input error?
explanation: 400 Bad Request indicates the request could not be processed.

title: URL class view
question_text: How is a class-based APIView connected in urlpatterns?
explanation: Class-based views are connected using as_view().

title: Validate serializer
question_text: Which method runs serializer validation?
explanation: Call is_valid() before accessing validated_data or saving.

title: Validated values
question_text: Where are validated input values stored?
explanation: validated_data contains converted and validated input values.

title: Save serializer
question_text: Which method persists validated serializer data?
explanation: save() calls create() or update() as appropriate.

title: Serialized output
question_text: Which property contains serialized representation?
explanation: serializer.data contains the representation for output.

title: Read-only field
question_text: Which option makes a serializer field read-only?
explanation: The field option is read_only=True.

title: Write-only field
question_text: Which option accepts input but omits the field from output?
explanation: write_only=True is useful for values such as passwords.

title: ModelViewSet import
question_text: Where is ModelViewSet imported from?
explanation: ModelViewSet is in rest_framework.viewsets.

title: Router import
question_text: Where is DefaultRouter imported from?
explanation: DefaultRouter is provided by rest_framework.routers.

title: Register ViewSet
question_text: Which method registers a ViewSet on a router?
explanation: router.register() associates a prefix with a ViewSet.

title: ViewSet queryset
question_text: Which attribute commonly defines a ViewSet's records?
explanation: A ViewSet commonly defines queryset and serializer_class.

title: Serializer class setting
question_text: Which ViewSet attribute identifies its serializer?
explanation: serializer_class tells the view which serializer to use.

title: List action
question_text: Which ViewSet action lists a collection?
explanation: list handles collection GET requests.

title: Retrieve action
question_text: Which ViewSet action retrieves one object?
explanation: retrieve handles detail GET requests.

title: Create action
question_text: Which ViewSet action creates an object?
explanation: create handles POST to a collection.

title: Destroy action
question_text: Which ViewSet action deletes one object?
explanation: destroy handles DELETE on a detail route.

title: Browsable API
question_text: What is DRF's browsable API?
buggy_code: Open an API endpoint in a browser.
option_d: An HTML interface to inspect and interact with endpoints
explanation: The browsable API provides a browser-based interface for API endpoints.

title: Many serialization
question_text: What does many=True do?
explanation: many=True tells a serializer to handle a list or queryset.

title: Serializer context
question_text: How is request passed to serializer context?
explanation: Pass request in the context dictionary; access it through self.context.

title: Field validation
question_text: Which method validates a serializer field named email?
explanation: DRF calls validate_<fieldname> for field-level validation.

title: Object validation
question_text: Which method validates multiple serializer fields together?
explanation: validate(attrs) performs object-level validation.

title: Custom create
question_text: Which method customizes creation in a serializer?
explanation: Override create() to control new instance creation.

title: Custom update
question_text: Which method customizes updates in a serializer?
explanation: Override update() to control changes to an existing instance.

title: Partial serializer update
question_text: How do you allow omitted fields during serializer validation?
explanation: partial=True is commonly used for PATCH requests.

title: PATCH method
question_text: Which HTTP method is commonly used for partial updates?
explanation: PATCH applies a partial modification to a resource.

title: PUT method
question_text: Which method commonly represents a full resource replacement/update?
explanation: PUT commonly represents full update or replacement semantics.

title: Authentication setting
question_text: Which setting configures default authentication classes?
explanation: Use DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES inside REST_FRAMEWORK.

title: Permission setting
question_text: Which setting configures default permission classes?
explanation: Use DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES inside REST_FRAMEWORK.

title: AllowAny
question_text: Which permission class permits unrestricted access?
explanation: AllowAny does not require authentication.

title: Authenticated
question_text: Which permission class requires an authenticated user?
explanation: IsAuthenticated checks request.user.is_authenticated.

title: Admin user
question_text: Which built-in permission checks the user's is_staff flag?
explanation: IsAdminUser grants access to staff users.

title: Object permission method
question_text: Which method implements object-level checks in a custom permission?
explanation: DRF calls has_object_permission for object-level permission checks.

title: View permission method
question_text: Which method implements view-level permission checks?
explanation: Custom permissions implement has_permission(request, view).

title: Token app
question_text: Which app enables DRF's built-in token model?
explanation: Add rest_framework.authtoken to INSTALLED_APPS.

title: Token authentication class
question_text: Which class enables DRF built-in token authentication?
explanation: TokenAuthentication is in rest_framework.authentication.

title: Session authentication
question_text: Which class uses Django sessions for API authentication?
explanation: SessionAuthentication uses Django's session framework.

title: Basic authentication
question_text: Which class implements HTTP Basic authentication?
explanation: BasicAuthentication parses credentials from the Authorization header.

title: Page number pagination
question_text: Which class paginates using page numbers?
explanation: PageNumberPagination uses page-number query parameters.

title: Page size setting
question_text: Which REST_FRAMEWORK option sets a default page size?
explanation: PAGE_SIZE sets the default page size for supported pagination classes.

title: Django filter backend
question_text: Where is DjangoFilterBackend imported from?
explanation: DjangoFilterBackend is provided by django-filter.

title: Search backend
question_text: Which DRF backend supports search query parameters?
explanation: SearchFilter uses search_fields.

title: Ordering backend
question_text: Which backend supports ordering query parameters?
explanation: OrderingFilter allows ordering on configured fields.

title: Throttle classes setting
question_text: Which setting configures default throttle classes?
explanation: DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CLASSES configures the throttle policies.

title: Throttle rates setting
question_text: Which setting maps throttle scopes to request rates?
explanation: DEFAULT_THROTTLE_RATES maps scopes to rates such as 100/hour.

title: Validation exception
question_text: Which exception is standard for serializer validation errors?
explanation: serializers.ValidationError is used for serializer validation failures.

title: API test client
question_text: Which client is designed for testing DRF endpoints?
explanation: APIClient provides methods for testing API requests.

title: API request factory
question_text: Which utility creates request objects for direct API view tests?
explanation: APIRequestFactory creates requests suitable for DRF view tests.

title: Serializer errors
question_text: Where are validation errors stored if is_valid() returns False?
explanation: serializer.errors contains field and non-field validation errors.

title: Browsable API auth URLs
question_text: Which include adds DRF browsable API login/logout routes?
explanation: Include rest_framework.urls for browsable API login/logout.

title: Writable nested serializers
question_text: Why may writable nested serializers need custom create/update methods?
explanation: DRF cannot infer all nested create/update behavior; implement explicit persistence logic.

title: Serializer source
question_text: What does source='user.username' do?
option_b: Maps the field to a related attribute path
explanation: source maps a serializer field to an attribute or related attribute.

title: SerializerMethodField
question_text: Which method is called for a field named total?
explanation: SerializerMethodField calls get_<field_name>(self, obj) by default.

title: HiddenField
question_text: Which field supplies a value internally without exposing it in output?
explanation: HiddenField supplies a value during deserialization and is not included in output.

title: Current user default
question_text: Which default can populate a hidden serializer field from request context?
explanation: CurrentUserDefault reads the current user from serializer request context.

title: Read-only Meta
question_text: Which ModelSerializer Meta option marks fields read-only?
explanation: read_only_fields is the supported Meta option.

title: Extra kwargs
question_text: Which ModelSerializer Meta option customizes generated fields?
explanation: extra_kwargs customizes options on generated serializer fields.

title: Dynamic fields
question_text: Where can serializer fields be changed per instance?
explanation: A serializer can alter self.fields in __init__ after calling super().__init__().

title: Dynamic queryset
question_text: Which generic view method should be overridden for a request-specific queryset?
explanation: Override get_queryset() to scope results to the current request/user.

title: Dynamic serializer
question_text: Which method selects a serializer class dynamically?
explanation: get_serializer_class() selects the serializer class based on action or request.

title: Apply filters
question_text: Which method applies configured filter backends to a queryset?
explanation: GenericAPIView.filter_queryset() applies configured filter backends.

title: Object lookup
question_text: Which generic view method retrieves an object and checks object permissions?
explanation: get_object() retrieves the object and calls object permission checks.

title: Custom ViewSet action
question_text: Which decorator adds a custom ViewSet route?
explanation: Import action from rest_framework.decorators.

title: Action import
question_text: Where is the action decorator imported from?
explanation: The action decorator is in rest_framework.decorators.

title: Detail action
question_text: What does detail=True mean on a ViewSet action?
option_a: The route targets an individual object
explanation: detail=True creates an action route for a single resource, normally including its lookup value.

title: Exception handler setting
question_text: Which setting configures a custom DRF exception handler?
explanation: EXCEPTION_HANDLER points to a custom exception formatting function.

title: Content negotiation
question_text: How does DRF choose a response renderer?
buggy_code: A request accepts multiple media types.
option_c: By content negotiation using accepted media types and configured renderers
explanation: DRF negotiates the response representation from the request and available renderers.

title: JSON renderer
question_text: Which renderer produces JSON output?
explanation: JSONRenderer renders response data as JSON.

title: JSON parser
question_text: Which parser handles application/json request bodies?
explanation: JSONParser parses JSON request content.

title: Multipart parser
question_text: Which parser handles multipart/form-data uploads?
explanation: MultiPartParser parses multipart form submissions including files.

title: File serializer field
question_text: Which serializer field represents an uploaded file?
explanation: FileField handles uploaded files; ImageField specializes in images.

title: Custom pagination response
question_text: Which method customizes a pagination response body?
explanation: Custom pagination classes implement get_paginated_response(data).

title: Cursor pagination ordering
question_text: What is important for stable cursor pagination?
option_a: A consistent ordering field, commonly unique or nearly unique
explanation: Cursor pagination needs consistent ordering to avoid unstable page boundaries.

title: Scoped throttling
question_text: Which view attribute identifies a rate scope for ScopedRateThrottle?
explanation: ScopedRateThrottle reads the view's throttle_scope.

title: Scoped throttle class
question_text: Which throttle class uses a view's throttle_scope?
explanation: ScopedRateThrottle applies the rate configured for the scope.

title: Authentication order
question_text: What happens when multiple authentication classes are configured?
option_b: DRF tries them in order and uses the first successful authentication
explanation: Authentication classes are tried in order; the first successful authenticator sets request.user and request.auth.

title: 401 or 403
question_text: When can DRF return 401 for an unauthenticated denied request?
buggy_code: An authenticator supplies a WWW-Authenticate header.
option_a: When the highest-priority authentication class provides a WWW-Authenticate header
explanation: Unauthenticated denials may be 401 or 403 depending on the authentication scheme and WWW-Authenticate behavior.

title: Session CSRF
question_text: Why can SessionAuthentication require CSRF for POST?
buggy_code: A logged-in browser sends a POST request.
option_a: Every JSON request always requires CSRF
option_d: Unsafe authenticated session requests are subject to CSRF checks
explanation: SessionAuthentication enforces CSRF checks for authenticated unsafe requests.

title: Versioning setting
question_text: Which setting configures DRF's default versioning scheme?
explanation: DEFAULT_VERSIONING_CLASS selects a versioning scheme such as URLPathVersioning.

title: OpenAPI AutoSchema
question_text: Which class is used for DRF OpenAPI schema generation?
explanation: AutoSchema is DRF's OpenAPI schema generation class.

title: Not found exception
question_text: Which exception is appropriate to signal a missing API resource?
explanation: DRF's NotFound exception represents an HTTP 404 response.

title: perform_create
question_text: Why override perform_create() in a generic view or ViewSet?
option_d: To customize saving, such as assigning request.user
explanation: perform_create() is a hook for customizing serializer.save(), for example serializer.save(owner=request.user).

title: Save extra values
question_text: How can request.user be added during serializer save without accepting it from client data?
explanation: serializer.save(owner=request.user) passes server-controlled values to create/update.

title: Atomic API writes
question_text: How should multiple database writes be grouped so they roll back together on error?
buggy_code: create order then create order lines
explanation: transaction.atomic() provides all-or-nothing transaction behavior.

title: N plus one serializer
question_text: Why can accessing obj.author.name in a serializer method cause N+1 queries?
option_a: Each object may trigger a separate related-object query
explanation: Use select_related for single-valued relations to fetch them efficiently.
